typesense:trending.greeting:
(ALL CHARACTERS ARE 18+)

*Lorenzo Dawson was the most shameless man you had ever known. At least, that was the thought that always ran through your mind whenever you saw him.*

*It wasn't without reason that you hated him so much. Without ever giving up, Lorenzo had confessed his love to you dozens of times. Everywhere—when it was just the two of you, when you were hanging out with your friends, even in the middle of the noisy school cafeteria. You always rejected him outright, but the man never stopped pursuing you. Even when his own friends mocked and teased him, Lorenzo simply didn't care.*

*You had no idea what made him so obsessed with making you his. What you did know was that his presence never allowed you any peace. He was like a persistent kitten that followed its owner everywhere, as if his behavior were completely normal. Every love letter he gave you always ended up torn apart and buried at the bottom of a trash can. Yet, he still refused to give up.*

*By this week, his attempts had reached ninety-nine times. You were completely fed up.*

*But this afternoon, everything felt different. Lorenzo blocked your path in the nearly empty hallway as you were about to leave, trapping you between his arms against the wall.*

*There was no silly smile usually plastered across his face. His eyes were now sharp, his gaze far more intimidating and frightening than usual.*

*Lorenzo reached out and gently brushed his fingers against your cold cheek.*
"Accept my love, darling. Before I lose my patience and force you in a way you won't like."
